# Diagnose/refine the CTD superposition: iterative outlier-rejection Kabsch
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64)"}
def fetch(u):
    r=requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=120); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
accs={"WORM":"O02161","YEAST":"Q01852","HUMAN":"O43615"}
seqs={k:"".join(fetch(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{v}.fasta").strip().split("\n")[1:]) for k,v in accs.items()}
B62_txt="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
rows=B62_txt.strip().split("\n"); aa=rows[0].split(); B62={}
for line in rows[1:]:
    p=line.split()
    for j,x in enumerate(p[1:]): B62[(p[0],aa[j])]=int(x)
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); pY[0,j]=2
    S=np.array([[sc(a,b) for b in s2] for a in s1],float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c=(M[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(c));M[i,j]=c[k]+S[i-1,j-1];pM[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge,Iy[i-1,j]+go);k=int(np.argmax(c));Ix[i,j]=c[k];pX[i,j]=k
            c=(M[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(c));Iy[i,j]=c[k];pY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]))); A=[];Bb=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);Bb.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);Bb.append('-');ns=pX[i,j];i-=1;st=ns
        else: A.append('-');Bb.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1;st=ns
        if i==0 and j>0 and st!=2: st=2
        if j==0 and i>0 and st!=1: st=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bb))
def mapping(ref,qry):
    A,Bb=nw(ref,qry); i=j=0; mp={}
    for x,y in zip(A,Bb):
        if x!='-': i+=1
        if y!='-': j+=1
        if x!='-': mp[i]=(j if y!='-' else None,x,y)
    return mp
mp_h=mapping(seqs["HUMAN"],seqs["WORM"]); mp_y=mapping(seqs["YEAST"],seqs["WORM"])
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(txt, chain='A'):
    prot=[];het=[]
    for l in txt.split("\n"):
        t=l[:6].strip()
        if t in ('ATOM','HETATM'):
            if l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
            if l[21]!=chain: continue
            resn=l[17:20].strip()
            try: d=dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),resn=resn,resi=int(l[22:26]),
                        xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]),b=float(l[60:66] or 'nan'))
            except ValueError: continue
            (prot if resn in AA3 else het).append(d)
    return prot,het
worm_prot,_=parse(fetch("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-O02161-F1-model_v6.pdb"))
h_prot,h_het=parse(fetch("https://files.rcsb.org/download/2CW9.pdb"))
y_prot,_=parse(fetch("https://files.rcsb.org/download/2FXT.pdb"))
CA=lambda P:{a['resi']:a['xyz'] for a in P if a['name']=='CA'}
ca_w,ca_h,ca_y=CA(worm_prot),CA(h_prot),CA(y_prot)

def kabsch(P,Q):
    pm,qm=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);Pc,Qc=P-pm,Q-qm
    V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc);d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt));R=V@np.diag([1,1,d])@Wt
    dev=np.sqrt((((Pc@R)-Qc)**2).sum(1))
    return R,pm,qm,dev

def iterative_fit(P,Q,cut=4.0,iters=12):
    idx=np.arange(len(P))
    for _ in range(iters):
        R,pm,qm,dev=kabsch(P[idx],Q[idx])
        dall=np.sqrt(((((P-pm)@R)-(Q-qm))**2).sum(1))
        new=np.where(dall<cut)[0]
        if len(new)<20: break
        if len(new)==len(idx) and np.array_equal(new,idx): break
        idx=new
    R,pm,qm,dev=kabsch(P[idx],Q[idx])
    dall=np.sqrt(((((P-pm)@R)-(Q-qm))**2).sum(1))
    return idx,float(np.sqrt((dev**2).mean())),dall,R,pm,qm

out={}
for tag,mp,cref in [("human_2CW9",mp_h,ca_h),("yeast_2FXT",mp_y,ca_y)]:
    pairs=[(r,v[0]) for r,v in mp.items() if v[0] is not None and r in cref and v[0] in ca_w]
    P=np.array([cref[r] for r,_ in pairs]);Q=np.array([ca_w[q] for _,q in pairs])
    idx,rmsd_core,dall,R,pm,qm=iterative_fit(P,Q)
    print(f"{tag}: pairs={len(pairs)}  core n={len(idx)} ({100*len(idx)/len(pairs):.0f}%)  core RMSD={rmsd_core:.2f} A  median dev(all)={np.median(dall):.2f} A  frac<4A={np.mean(dall<4):.2f}  frac<2A={np.mean(dall<2):.2f}")
    out[tag]=dict(pairs=pairs,dall=dall,idx=idx,rmsd=rmsd_core,R=R,pm=pm,qm=qm,P=P,Q=Q)

# where do the deviations sit? report worst contiguous stretches vs 2CW9
tag="human_2CW9"; o=out[tag]
res_w=np.array([p[1] for p in o['pairs']]); res_h=np.array([p[0] for p in o['pairs']])
bad=res_w[o['dall']>4]
print("\nTIN-44 residues deviating >4 A from 2CW9 after core fit:", bad.tolist())
print("TIN-44 residues within 2 A:", int((o['dall']<2).sum()), "of", len(res_w))

# cavity probe test: after superposition, is the 1PE cavity of 2CW9 empty in the TIN-44 model?
lig=[a for a in h_het if a['resn']=='1PE']
R,pm,qm=o['R'],o['pm'],o['qm']
wall=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in worm_prot])   # all worm heavy atoms
wall_t=wall  # keep worm frame; transform ligand into worm frame instead
# transform: (P-pm)@R ~ (Q-qm)  =>  worm_frame(x_human) = (x-pm)@R + qm
def to_worm(x): return (x-pm)@R+qm
occ=[]
for a in lig:
    p=to_worm(a['xyz'])
    d=np.linalg.norm(wall-p,axis=1)
    occ.append(d.min())
occ=np.array(occ)
print(f"\nCavity probe test: {len(lig)} 1PE atoms mapped into the TIN-44 model frame.")
print(f"  min distance to nearest TIN-44 heavy atom: median {np.median(occ):.2f} A, range {occ.min():.2f}-{occ.max():.2f} A")
print(f"  atoms with >=3.0 A clearance (cavity retained at that point): {np.mean(occ>=3.0)*100:.0f}%")
print(f"  atoms clashing (<2.5 A, cavity filled in TIN-44): {np.mean(occ<2.5)*100:.0f}%")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,4.5))
ax=axes[0]
ax.scatter(res_w,o['dall'],s=12,c=['#2f855a' if d<4 else '#c53030' for d in o['dall']])
ax.axhline(4,ls='--',c='grey'); ax.set_xlabel('TIN-44 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('Calpha deviation (A)')
ax.set_title(f"TIN-44 model vs human TIMM44 CTD (2CW9)\ncore RMSD {o['rmsd']:.2f} A over {len(o['idx'])} Calpha")
ax=axes[1]
o2=out['yeast_2FXT']; rw2=np.array([p[1] for p in o2['pairs']])
ax.scatter(rw2,o2['dall'],s=12,c=['#2f855a' if d<4 else '#c53030' for d in o2['dall']])
ax.axhline(4,ls='--',c='grey'); ax.set_xlabel('TIN-44 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('Calpha deviation (A)')
ax.set_title(f"TIN-44 model vs yeast Tim44 CTD (2FXT)\ncore RMSD {o2['rmsd']:.2f} A over {len(o2['idx'])} Calpha")
ax=axes[2]
ax.hist(occ,bins=np.arange(0,9,0.5),color='#2b6cb0',edgecolor='w')
ax.axvline(3.0,ls='--',c='#c53030')
ax.set_xlabel('distance from mapped 1PE atom to nearest TIN-44 atom (A)')
ax.set_ylabel('ligand atoms'); ax.set_title('Is the human lipid-mimetic cavity\nopen in the TIN-44 model?')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
